extracted_span_text.description: A single-line value that semantic verification requires to be one exact contiguous substring of the selected raw text.

hadith_id.description: A permanent globally unique HADITH identifier.

isbn13.description: An ISBN-13 normalized to thirteen ASCII digits; semantic verification checks its checksum.

location.description: The physical location of an OCCURRENCE within its SOURCE_WITNESS.

occurrence_id.description: A permanent globally unique OCCURRENCE identifier.

ordinal.description: A position in a complete entity-specific printed sequence.

positive_integer.description: An integer from one through JavaScript's maximum safe integer, inclusive.

printed_hadith_number.description: A positive hadith number assigned by a printed SOURCE_WITNESS.

priority_score.description: A relative ordering value whose differences and ratios carry no meaning.

publication_year.description: A four-digit Gregorian publication year stated by a SOURCE_WITNESS.

raw_text.description: The nonempty preserved report body governed by the canonical text and whitespace policy.

record_type.description: The entity type represented by a core record.

reference_scheme.description: The optional printed reference parts used by a SOURCE_WITNESS; pages are universal.

schema_version.description: The explicit schema version selected by a core record.

section_id.description: A permanent descriptive ASCII slug unique within one SOURCE.

section_kind.description: A controlled classification for a source-authored division.

single_line_text.description: Nonempty NFC metadata text governed by the single-line whitespace policy.

source_id.description: A permanent globally unique descriptive ASCII slug for a SOURCE.

witness_id.description: A permanent globally unique descriptive ASCII slug for a SOURCE_WITNESS.
